title: PDF Watermark Hidden Behind White Text Boxes?
description: Diagnose a PDF watermark that disappears behind white fields. Preview a new marked copy and verify both the stamp and the text before you share.
direct: If a PDF watermark disappears exactly at the edge of white text boxes, check whether it sits behind the page content. Use a separate copy with the mark over the page, then check the text is still readable.
figureAlt: A paper page with an opaque white box crossing a diagonal DRAFT stamp and a translucent overlay held separately.
figureCaption: AI illustration of paper layers. The paper box shows how a foreground area can cover a background mark.
cards.decision.heading: Notice where the mark stops
cards.decision.body: A sharp cut along the same box edge suggests layering. A watermark that stays visible but looks pale over a bright area may need a stronger color or higher opacity instead.
sections.detail-1.heading: When the field must remain fillable
sections.detail-1.body: Keep an untouched source and test whether the saved copy still works as required. A page can look correct while its interactive behavior has changed. Follow the sender’s workflow when fields or existing signatures must stay valid.
sections.detail-2.heading: Make a checked reading copy
sections.detail-2.body: Space Sheep Studio develops PDF Watermark & Stamp for iPhone. Its preview lets you inspect the mark on individual pages before export. The export makes a separate marked PDF. Use it for a visible reading copy and check the final result.

steps.step-1.text: Inspect one affected page and one page without the boxes. If possible, start with an unmarked source to avoid stacking two versions of the same mark.
steps.step-2.text: Open the source in PDF Watermark & Stamp. Add a short mark and preview the affected page. Adjust opacity and size so both the mark and the field text remain visible.
steps.step-3.text: Export a separate PDF and reopen it in the viewer your recipient will use. Check the affected boxes, small text and any document features the recipient needs.
